name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
steps: Stand or sit tall and raise one arm straight overhead, then bend that elbow so your hand reaches down between your shoulder blades.
Reach your opposite hand over your head to gently grasp the bent elbow.
Pull the elbow softly back and slightly inward until you feel a comfortable stretch down the back of your upper arm and side.
Hold the stretch steadily with relaxed breathing on one side, then release gently and switch arms.
tips: Keep your rib cage down and head upright rather than pushing your chin forward into your forearm.
Avoid pulling aggressively on the elbow; apply steady, mild pressure.
